Financial inclusion/Social Security payment entities, independent client dispute authority, flexible basic accounts including limited noncommercial entities, coordinated public spending, entrepreneurship/intraenterprise innovation and targeted vulnerable-family transfers.

Citizen electric mobility/heating aid, study changed regulated retail tariff after two years/open to all retailers. State-backed business long-term electricity contracts, improve electrointensive criteria and cover 100% eligible indirect CO2 compensation costs (not every energy bill).

Industrial cogeneration, carbon-border adjustment/temporary subsidised maximum energy prices/crisis aid, demand aggregators, near-consumption renewable grid siting and storage access/hybrid use. Study competitive night tariff, distributed generation, domestic green hydrogen for hard-to-electrify uses and synthetic fuels where needed, offshore floating wind technology/auctions, urban/building grid upgrade. No blanket ban on all energy imports.

Circular economy/material reuse, agriculture/forest/marine/organic bioeconomy, electricity-market liquidity/independent retailer competition and EU coordination. Sustainable water use/supply works with supply security and provision in public management.

Electric vehicle aid/Moves redesign/increase, replacement aid for conventional vehicles 15+ years old with low-emission models, charging information and fewer higher-power/ultrafast points, simpler permits, green polluter-pays taxation preserving foral regimes.

Gender equality/empowerment, balanced decision presence, shared care/timing, equal-pay/pension-gap implementation and gender-violence resources/justice specialisation. No exact new quota or leave length.

Sexual consent determines sexual offence, administrative accreditation/legal aid/specialised judiciary and multidisciplinary support; follow LGTBI rights law with affected groups/counter hatred. No inferred detailed age/self-identification rule.
Work background on wages/productivity/education/demographic-digital-climate transitions, stable better jobs/training and adaptable labour regulation. No fixed shorter-week proposal here.
Social dialogue/active employment and autonomous Basque labour framework, regional/sector adaptation, gender equality/work-family/time policies and gender-award criteria in State procurement.

Employment/economic pact and productivity-linked wages with rights; regional agreements prevail when better for workers. Dual vocational/university training, targeted youth jobs, education-work linkage, migrant qualification/origin/circular recruitment and practical-trainee regulation begins.

Completes trainee contribution/cost/bureaucracy balance. Unemployment coverage up to 36 months linked to employability/active search, especially chronic hard-to-reintegrate workers. Digital skills/disability ordinary jobs/public quota increase, self-employed protection convergence respecting cooperative systems and anti-fraud.
Public pay-as-you-go/intergenerational sustainable pensions/Basque management; optional employment second pillar begins. Historical CPI rises not independently established policy achievement.

Employment and individual pension pillars explicitly complementary, never substitute/weaken public pillar. Statutory economic-management transfer retains unitary/solidarity character; CPI indexation, contributory-funding separation/public budget support, structural gender-gap correction and reserve withdrawal 3% exceptional limit.

Move improper Social Security costs/company bonuses/administration to State budget, encourage negotiated company pension plans/fiscal policy. Legal safe orderly migrant workforce; migrants with work contract need not pass current arraigo process, not unconditional regularisation of everyone.

European project/market/human rights/plural nations, strategic industrial/raw-material/external/security autonomy and unified measures to protect/help Ukrainians. No specific defence spending percentage or weapon mechanism.

Effective Basque EU participation/ECOFIN/JAI, Atlantic macroregion/energy/rail/ocean cooperation, common EU bank deposit guarantee, territorial European-election constituencies, cross-border rail, official Basque/Catalan/Galician presence and student access across Pyrenees.
Industry/innovation/public-private investment rationale, energy/climate competitiveness/recovery funds and barriers. Stated Basque 25% industry GDP is background, not a new target.

Primary/commercial/tourism roles, public-private industrial risk projects, energy coordination, regional PERTE/direct projects and co-management, regional industry-law competence, industrial/applied innovation.

Applied industrial research/digital solutions/region strengths/talent/open innovation and unitary European patent adhesion. Cooperativism contributions on employment earnings excluding returns; defend complementary Lagun Aro model, not substitute public pensions.

Industrial data/AI/cybersecurity culture/professional sector, international market/finance/cooperation/trade defence/consortia and SME/self-employed guarantees/management/technology; remove obsolete rules and bureaucratic barriers.

Tourism quality/natural-cultural heritage/digitalisation/skills rather than low-value precarious model. Proximity commerce physical-digital integration/finance/skills and pedestrian environments with less vehicle circulation.

Agriculture/forestry succession/finance/land/succession rules, food-chain legal/market improvements and dairy arrangements, digital waste reduction, PAC simplification/fund execution and mirror clauses for third-country production, sustainable livestock/ecological practices/research.

Basque agricultural/EU competence/bilateral insurance/domestic-animal basic-law scope, gender/renewable rural use. Fishing succession/dual study/women hiring/retirement coefficients based on time away, family firm continuity, quotas/producer organisations/traceability/labelling/seasonal fish/tourism/biodiversity and decarbonised fleet fund.

Regional fish funds unused allocations reassignment to avoid losing funds, inspection transfer/EU rule transposition without duplicate penalty and external fishing agreements/regional fisheries sustainability.

Social cohesion/child poverty/equity/family guarantee, young emancipation, public rental promotion and emergency support respecting Basque housing powers. Competence-based rejection of proposals does not establish rent-cap opposition; exact cap stance absent.

Loiola homes and tenant/landlord balance, family/shared care/legal migration/jobs, universal equitable health. Specialist training/health competence, adjust MIR places/accreditation, Basque/Navarra drug-price participation, rare/degenerative research/care and medicinal cannabis regulation; family-type equality.

Child sexual violence/exploitation/image removal, analyse youth pornography/internet safeguards and comprehensive gender-sensitive anti-trafficking law with vulnerable-child protection. No precise universal age-verification method.

Education plural/inclusive/values/digital/sustainable, Statute powers/own model and LOMLOE contributions; preserve Basque university-entry/EBAU competence. No identical nationwide examination commitment.

Integrated lifelong vocational/Basque qualification framework/applied innovation, Basque university/science and regional mobility, foreign degree-recognition transfer, university governance/European projects/dual degrees/excellence/ambitious investment (no exact GDP figure).

Intermodal sustainable transport/road-to-rail freight; Basque ports/airports/rail transfer, local commuter infrastructure investment and transfer, finish high-speed Y/integrate Atlantic/Aquitaine/Navarra/Burgos links. Traffic statistics and benefits attributed.

Via Irun 2030, transfer Hondarribia/Loiu/Foronda airports and cross-border/Navarra coordination, remove Pasaia national-interest designation, logistics/rail/Lezo/bay regeneration and universal accessible trains/stations. No exact free fare policy.
